charts.title: TOI-561 d: orbits around TOI-561
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-561's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-561 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lacedelli et al. 2022 (2022MNRAS.511.4551L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LACEDELLI_ET_AL__2022): P 25.7124 d

charts.title: TOI-561 d: its transit
charts.description: TOI-561 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 377064495, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 16 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min early; 19-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
